correction_patch: P4.1 SCENARIO SUPPORT REPORT HARDENING (four review findings; no P4 redesign)
starting_head_subject: content(P3): add stage and encounter product projections

p4_1_findings_fixed.subject: explicit M14 registry required
p4_1_findings_fixed.was: ScenarioSupportReporter(database, registry=None) was accepted and only failed later inside _admit(); M14_REGISTRY_NOT_SUPPLIED was a reachable report state.
p4_1_findings_fixed.now: registry is a REQUIRED keyword-only parameter on both the constructor and build_scenario_support_report; a missing/None registry raises MissingM14RegistryError immediately at construction. M14_REGISTRY_NOT_SUPPLIED is no longer reachable in a report (it remains a valid P2 character-browsing state).

p4_1_findings_fixed.subject: product service authority bypass
p4_1_findings_fixed.was: the constructor accepted product_service=... without verifying it used the same database, content version and M14 registry as the reporter, so character/M14 facts and M15 admission facts could come from different authorities.
p4_1_findings_fixed.now: the product_service injection seam is REMOVED (it is absent from the signature and from the module source). The service is always built internally as ContentProductService(database, registry=registry), giving one authority chain and one registry. A test proves injection is a TypeError and that reporter.products is bound to the same database.

p4_1_findings_fixed.subject: strict M15 outcome gate
p4_1_findings_fixed.was: the gate accepted any outcome that appeared in ADMISSION_OUTCOMES and had rejected == true, so a future vocabulary widening would have been auto-accepted.
p4_1_findings_fixed.now: P4 accepts EXACTLY the reviewed outcome REJECTED (compared against the ACCEPTED_M15_OUTCOME literal, not against the vocabulary). ADMISSION_OUTCOMES is still reported as authority metadata with outcome_vocabulary_is_authority_metadata_only = true. future_outcome_auto_extension = false.

p4_1_findings_fixed.subject: malformed scenario shape validation
p4_1_findings_fixed.was: package_sha256 proved content integrity only, so an incorrectly typed field (e.g. waves = {}) was silently treated as empty by _sequence().
p4_1_findings_fixed.now: a structural shape check runs before report construction and is independent of package_sha256. Tests use malformed inputs with a CORRECTLY recomputed hash to prove independence.

registry_requirement.missing_registry: TypeError (no default on the keyword-only parameter)
registry_requirement.reason: every Scenario Support Report performs M15 admission, which needs an authoritative M14 registry, so there is no registry-free report mode

authority_chain: M15 admission against the same registry and content version
product_service_authority.verification: a test asserts reporter.products.database is the reporter's database, that the service reports the same game_version and m14_registry_supplied, and that a version-mixed pairing cannot be constructed at all

m15_outcome_gate.compared_against: the literal, NOT the ADMISSION_OUTCOMES vocabulary
m15_outcome_gate.outcome_vocabulary_role: reported as authority metadata only (admission_outcome_vocabulary + outcome_vocabulary_is_authority_metadata_only = true)
proven_cases: DEFERRED + rejected=true fails closed even when ADMISSION_OUTCOMES is widened to include DEFERRED
REJECTED + a non-false may_* fails closed

minimal_input_shape_validation.runs_before: report construction (inside _validate, before any product or admission work)
minimal_input_shape_validation.independent_of: package_sha256 -- hash integrity and shape validity are two separate checks and neither substitutes for the other

waves: every wave has an enemies key

not_validated_here: player count upper bound (the ScenarioCompiler owns the 1..4 team bound)

module_placement.rationale: a new namespace above game_data / content_support / content_planner, so no frozen layer needed modification

two_independent_validity_checks: package_sha256 content integrity (stable_hash over the package minus its own hash key)
input_schema.package_hash_verification: stable_hash over the package minus its own package_sha256 key, compared to the recorded value; a mismatch raises MalformedScenarioPackageError before consumption
input_schema.hash_verification_cost: free -- it uses the public stable_hash convention and duplicates no ScenarioCompiler internals

checks: Scenario Package game_version == M14 registry content_version

reported: players (instance_id, slot, avatar_id, static loadout presence)
enemy occurrences (instance_id, requested monster id, level, resolution record)
rules as their existing explicit P1 resolution records

m14_authority.authority: content_support public API via ContentProductService / CharacterProduct (P2), always built internally with the reporter's own registry
m14_authority.missing_row_behaviour: NO_M14_ROW preserved with null capability and null eligibility

monster_ai_ledger.note: a targeted 14-row binding ledger, NOT a per-entity census over 628 Monsters

family_level_monster_authority.reason: the pinned family census records behaviour_mapped = 0 for the Monster family
family_level_monster_authority.variant_identity_statement: a MONSTER_VARIANT resolved to a canonical parent is a static identity success, not a runtime-support success

family_level_stage_authority.stage_static_source: ContentProductService / StageProduct (P3); source_stage_id absent is reported plainly and is not an error

unresolved_content_categories.note: a missing optional static stat is not the same fact as an M15 execution rejection, and the report keeps their sources separate

non_effect_guarantees.source: content_planner.NonEffects (public M15 representation), summed across results; no independent counters are invented

determinism_copy_policy.hash: report_sha256 = stable_hash(report without the hash field)
determinism_copy_policy.ordering: all collections explicitly sorted; counts dicts sorted by key
determinism_copy_policy.representation: plain dict document; immutable typing explicitly NOT claimed
determinism_copy_policy.copy_isolation: deepcopy before return; a caller mutation cannot reach another result or any artefact payload
determinism_copy_policy.note: the P4.1 metadata additions changed the report hashes; the P4.1 census re-recorded them

A_free.scenario: 1105 Natasha, no source Stage, one custom enemy wave (1002020 @ level 80)
A_free.proves: Stage absence is not an error

B_stage_backed.proves: Stage Buff 3110001, encounter source mode boss, P0 variant-only Monster identity (100401401 -> 1004014, 100402601 -> 1004026)

C_m14_missing.proves: M14 NO_M14_ROW (8 skills) is distinct from M15 SKILL_NOT_IN_REGISTRY (8 results); no capability or eligibility fabricated

fixtures.also: 1105 appears in A and B as the normal M14-linked avatar (COMPLETE, 6/6 linked)

new.p4_1_additions: RegistryRequiredTest (7), InputContractTest shape-validation additions (2 methods covering 12 malformed + 4 accepted-edge cases), M15AdmissionTest outcome-gate additions (4) = 12 new tests (46 -> 58)
